--- page 2 ---
Your plans for the
future just got bigger.
And better.
You’ve got a pretty clear idea of where you and your family are headed. You just need a
better way to get there: Introducing the all-new 2020 Hyundai Palisade.
The spacious 3-row Palisade SUV reflects our core belief in the power of better. Palisade
is all about new ideas for smarter and more stylish designs. Friendlier technologies. And
safer, more secure driving.
As our new flagship SUV, Palisade is not just better, but bigger too. It’s big on room,
with a choice of 7- or 8-passenger seating capacity across three wide rows. It’s big on
efficient power, with a new 3.8L GDI V6 engine that generates up to 291 horsepower
with an EPA-estimated 26 MPG on the highway.1 And it’s big on making things happen,
with available HTRAC All Wheel Drive, a towing capacity of up to 5,000 pounds, and up
to 86.4 cubic feet of usable cargo space.
Palisade is especially big on comfort and convenience – check out the easy 3rd-row
access offered by one-touch sliding 2nd-row seats. And the power-folding/reclining
seating that’s available in the 3rd row. Available premium features like a hands-free smart
liftgate, dual sunroof, wireless device charging and seven USB outlets are complimented
by an arsenal of Hyundai SmartSense safety technologies – many of which come
standard on every Palisade trim level.
So go ahead and start making plans. The bigger, the better.
“…a tantalizing new option for families looking for
a big, flexible, and amenity rich crossover SUV.”2
– Kelley Blue Book’s KBB.com
